title: ‘Awards Chatter’ Pod: Noah Wyle on the “Very Rare Second Lightning Strike” of ‘The Pitt’ After ‘ER’ and His 16 “Wilderness Years” in Between Them
summary: The defending winner of the best actor in a drama series Emmy, who is now at work on season three of the show, also reflects on how Dr. Robby is "closer to who I am than I've ever played a character before" and why "the need for this show is greater than the need for 'ER' was."
